calculation_handling.description: Enacting instruction that edits the list in regulation 80.5.40.40(1) and adds item (I); no regulation of its own.
Adds cladding on the original exterior surface of a main wall or an addition, with the vents, pipes and utility equipment beneath it, to the items listed in regulation 80.5.40.40(1).
calculation_handling.gaps: The effect depends on the lead-in of regulation 80.5.40.40(1), which is not part of this unit.

80.5.40.40(1)(I)@1075-2026.explanation: Adds cladding applied over the original exterior surface of a main wall, or over an addition or extension, including vents, pipes and utility equipment beneath the cladding, to the list of items in regulation 80.5.40.40(1).
